notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page; budget 1-2). New state: Cliopatria has no Stolberg row.

SCOPE. The page is silent on how the county ended, on area, on territory lost and on wars. The end at 1806 is a convention (confidence 1): the lines Stolberg-Stolberg, Stolberg-Wernigerode and Stolberg-Rochefort continued; the Reformation came in 1539 and membership of the Upper Saxon Circle in 1512 (an association). The exclaves Konigstein (Taunus) and Rochefort (Ardennes) are drawn as small circles because the page names them as acquisitions.

SHAPES. Stolberg 10.95E 51.57N 18 km; Kelbra 11.05E 51.43N 10 km; Hohnstein 10.80E 51.50N 14 km; Wernigerode 10.79E 51.83N 14 km; Konigstein 8.47E 50.18N 8 km; Rochefort 5.22E 50.16N 10 km. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Stolberg (Harz)', 'Kelbra', 'Heringen (Helme)', 'Wernigerode', 'Königstein im Taunus', 'Rochefort (Belgium)'.

NOT SETTLED. (1) The end; (2) the givers of every acquisition; (3) 1413 or 1417 for Kelbra and Heringen.

COUNTERPARTS NEEDING DOSSIERS: county-of-hohnstein (no row).

REVISION 2026-10-25 (after review). (1) 1581: Königstein lost to electorate-of-mainz (Königstein page 'By 1581, Königstein belonged to the Electorate of Mainz'; confidence 2, the year is the page's 'by' date); K4 split at 1581; the mirror gain is in the Mainz dossier. (2) End: the Stolberg-Wernigerode page dates the mediatisation 1807 (Kingdom of Westphalia), so the end moves from the 1806 convention to 1807, confidence 2, successor kingdom-of-westphalia. The page covers only the Wernigerode line; Stolberg-Stolberg and Stolberg-Rossla are not followed, so the land handed to Westphalia is the four Harz circles. (3) Rochefort: the Rochefort (Belgium) page was opened and is silent on the Counts of Stolberg and on 1544, the Stolberg-Wernigerode page does not mention Rochefort; Rochefort stays drawn to 1806 with no loss (gap: page silent; the French annexation of the Ardennes in the 1790s is not on any page opened). (4) Counterpart of the end event is kingdom-of-westphalia (Cliopatria row 1809..1813 exists, no dossier yet).
